verdict.rationale: Bugbot runs headlessly as a hosted service: it reviews every PR update automatically in the background and can be triggered by PR comments (`bugbot run`) across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps. A community user reports invoking it on request from a GitHub Action, which corroborates CI-driven use. However, there is no documented CLI, API, or CI-native step, so pipeline automation relies on PR events and comment-trigger workarounds. Missing for 10: documented CLI/API or official CI action for programmatic invocation, machine-readable results or exit codes for gating pipelines, first-party docs on CI integration.
